title: Uncertainty as a Fairness Measure
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper focuses on fairness related to demographic attributes such as race, gender, and age, not religion or faith.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its analysis is focused on quantifying bias and fairness using uncertainty measures for demographic groups (race, gender, age) in datasets like COMPAS, Adult, and D-Vlog.
